mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.5% compresses corporate borrowing costs and reduces equity valuation multiples, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic context.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.5% across any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 2000 and retail sales below 350000 indicate broad consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST < 2000 and RSAFS < 350000.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (indicated by high industrial production growth), S&P 500 underperforms as economic momentum peaks, generating negative forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion (INDPRO growth > 2% annually and UNRATE < 4.5%).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 115 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 115.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 2000 thousand units indicate robust consumer demand for housing, boosting economic growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 2000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in unemployment rate above 5.0% and declines in non-farm payrolls below 134000 signal labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS < 134000.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (characterized by rising federal funds rates), S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.25% in 3 months).
